item.title: Palmer Luckey 就 Nvidia CEO 人事变动发表看法
item.description: TechCrunch 报道，Anduril CEO Palmer Luckey 在纽约时报 DealBook Summit 上就 Nvidia 领导层变动发表看法，认为相关变动可能影响美国产业竞争力，并呼吁 Nvidia 恢复创始人黄仁勋的 CEO 职位。报道称，已有超过 20 万人联署请愿，包括马斯克及多家科技公司 CEO；Nvidia 临时 CEO Colette Kress 在财报电话会上表示，公司暂无重新任命黄仁勋的计划。（TechCrunch：AI（RSS））

item.title: Meta 欢迎 Loblaw 成为 Muse 首家加拿大零售合作伙伴 / Meta Welcomes Loblaw as First Canadian Retail Partner to Muse
item.description: Starting today, Loblaw is bringing its catalogue to Muse as a partner connector, the first Canadian retailer to do so. Connectors are a big reason Muse can do so much. Canadians can connect their Muse to apps they already use, including Gmail, Google Calendar and Instagram, so it can help them manage email, coordinate schedules and draw on saved content to get everyday tasks done. With participating Loblaw banners, Canadian shoppers can now ask Muse to help with meal planning, build their basket（Meta AI / Muse Newsroom）
